changelog: Created memory constraint `.lovable/memory/constraints/version-validators-accept-dev-fallback.md` to ensure future semver validators permit the `0.0.0-dev` local fallback suffix.
Widened `SEMVER_PATTERN` in `scripts/sync-manifest-version.mjs`, `scripts/check-built-manifest-csp.mjs`, and `vite.config.extension.ts` to accept prerelease/build suffixes (e.g. `0.0.0-dev`).
Updated semver regex in `scripts/check-prompts-info-json.mjs` and `scripts/bump-version.mjs` to maintain project-wide consistency.
Resolved deterministic Vitest failures in `macro-controller-recovery.test.ts` caused by strict `X.Y.Z` matching against the local `0.0.0-dev` version.
Fixed extension build pipeline (`pnpm run build:extension`) by allowing manifest version sync to pass with the dev-mode fallback.
